body:
Every pupil at a secondary school should be required to wear a uniform, because it reduces competition over clothing and helps students concentrate on their lessons.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Boys and girls learn more effectively when they are taught in separate classes, free from the distractions that the other sex can bring to a lesson.

To what extent do you agree or disagree with this opinion?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Schools should teach children how to manage money, including saving, budgeting and borrowing, rather than leaving this knowledge to parents and chance.

Do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

A growing number of schools are banning mobile phones during lessons, and in many cases during breaks as well.

Do you think this is a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people think that small classes allow teachers to give each pupil more individual attention and therefore produce better results. Others believe that large classes are acceptable if the teacher is well trained and the lessons are well organised.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

While some argue that schools should concentrate on academic subjects alone, others believe that sport, music and drama are just as important to a young person's education.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

While some argue that history should remain a compulsory subject in schools, others believe the curriculum should focus on skills such as coding, economics and data analysis, which prepare pupils for future careers.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Some people think that foreign language lessons should focus mainly on grammar rules and accurate writing. Others argue that learners should spend most of their time speaking and listening.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many teenagers feel under pressure from their friends and social circles to look a certain way, and this can seriously damage their confidence.

What are the causes of this problem?

What can be done to help young people feel more comfortable with their appearance?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Increasing numbers of parents are asking their young children to sit competitive entrance examinations for selective schools at the age of seven or eight.

Why is this happening?

How can schools and governments reduce the pressure that these tests place on young children?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Pupils in many countries have a long break of several weeks each summer, and a good deal of what they learned during the year is often forgotten by the autumn.

What problems does this create for pupils and their teachers?

What measures could schools and families take to reduce this loss of learning?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many secondary schools now arrange exchange trips in which pupils stay with a host family in another country for two or three weeks.

Do you think the advantages of school exchange trips outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many teenagers now take part-time jobs in shops, cafes and restaurants while they are still studying at school.

To what extent do the advantages of part-time work for teenagers outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Translation apps on mobile phones now allow travellers to hold a basic conversation in almost any language, so fewer people feel the need to learn a foreign language properly.

To what extent do the advantages of translation apps outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Many schools have cut back on field trips and science lessons held outside the classroom because of safety worries, and this has reduced the practical experience pupils receive.

Why is this the case?

What effects might this have on children's learning and confidence?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Studying novels and poetry at school is valued less than science and mathematics, even though these texts teach pupils a great deal about people and society.

What are the reasons for this?

Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Governments disagree about whether children should begin learning a foreign language in primary school or wait until they reach secondary school.

Why do some governments prefer an earlier start?

Does a late start leave pupils at a real disadvantage, or can older learners catch up quickly?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
